Customer analytics interpretation

Revenue per customer and average order value answer different questions. AOV is net revenue ÷ distinct orders; gross margin captures direct product cost but excludes salaries, fulfillment and marketing.

This sample does not include marketing spend, so the acquisition chart cannot support ROI or customer-acquisition-cost conclusions.

The preview is a locally interactive HTML companion. The ZIP also contains the native editable Power BI Project (.pbip) with the complete star schema and DAX measures. Synthetic sample figures are illustrative, not actual financial results. Returns are attributed to the original order month and the newest 14 days are censored for completed returns.
